run_tacto_digit_simulation: run a PyBullet simulation with TACTO DIGIT tactile sensor and 6DoF object control panel
create_tacto_sensor: create a TACTO Sensor instance with a background image and hydra config parameters
add_body_to_sensor: add a PyBulletX Body object to the TACTO sensor for tactile contact tracking
render_tacto_images: render color and depth images from the TACTO sensor and update the GUI display
start_simulation_thread: start a PyBulletX SimulationThread to run stepSimulation in a background thread at real time
